description: Solution steps are argv arrays, never shell strings.

instance.title: Internal names stopped resolving
instance.mission: Requests to api.internal fail from the app container. Find out why and restore resolution.
hints: Which server is the container actually asking?
Compare /etc/resolv.conf with the resolver you expect.

reference_solution.explanation: resolv.conf points to a nameserver that does not exist; pointing it back at the zone resolver restores answers.
